prompt: Cinematic dark monochrome generative art inspired by Time-Lapse of the Star S301 Orbiting the Black Hole in the Center of the Galaxy. What does it feel like to zoom around a spinning supermassive black hole?   The featured video is an animation showing a time-lapse of 4 years of observations of the star S301 orbiting Sagittarius Rendered as fine white particles and light filaments on a pure black background, volumetric, dramatic, monochrome white on black, lots of negative space, high detail.
